name: reshade-osd
description: box with neither C++ mod loaded and ReShade drawing its own on-screen display: the one cell that shows whether a third party writing this back buffer keeps the game on its hardware plane

report.verdict: not a reported configuration - the deciding experiment for candidate 3 in present-hook-cost, 'be where ReShade is'

payloads.note: RenoDX DLSS addon; ReShade loads it from DllMain
older RenoDX addon; the .addon64x extension is not scanned, so it is inert
NVIDIA DLSSNR runtime 310.8.0.0, 165 MB, same install batch as the proxy

box-ReShade.ini with ShowFPS, ShowClock and ShowFrameTime on. This install has no shaders - EffectSearchPaths is empty and there is no reshade-shaders folder - so the OSD is how ReShade is made to write the back buffer without installing one, through the same runtime and the same write, minus the shader pass
leftover second config, read by nothing; declared because it is on the box
OptiScaler goes here; it must not be present in this configuration
and its nine libraries live in this folder

expect.note: neither C++ mod starts, so nothing of ours is in the composition tree and the window's PresentMode is ReShade's to keep or lose. UE4SS still maps dlls/main.dll and gates only start_mod on enabled.txt, so the DLL is present in the process and silent - asserted by its log staying empty, the way stock asserts it

manual.driver_vsync: the owner's word - not readable from a script
manual.framegen: the half this cell cannot reach on its own. NVIDIA's claim is about DLSS-G being ACTIVE, and frame generation lives in GameConfig.sav, which a profile reads and never writes. So this cell answers the plane question with frame generation as the menu leaves it; the framegen half needs the owner in the menu once
manual.monitors: three: 1920x1080 @ 75 Hz primary, 1920x1080 @ 100 Hz, 1080x1920 @ 75 Hz rotated; the game runs on the primary. The 2026-09-19 present cells were taken with only the primary connected - record which this cell had
